content_zh:
第17章 家庭教师五
对于家里太过热闹的场面有点受不了的律找了个借口便出了门。
连日以来都是艳阳高照的天气终于转向了凉爽，迎面而来的微风拂在脸上，感觉很舒服。
惬意的眯了眯眼睛，律享受着这难得的安静氛围，连日以来虽说不介意，但的确太过吵闹了些。
并盛街道两旁的樱花已经开放，被风吹下的花瓣在空中无声的飞舞，美得如梦似幻。
律有些失神，而正因如此，等他感觉到身后有人接近时，只感到后颈一痛，便失去了知觉。
而正在听reborn教意大利语的阿纲本来昏昏欲睡，却突然下意识的皱了皱眉。
“怎么了？”reborn有些警惕的问。
阿纲感受了一下，也说不上来到底怎么了，但却有种不好的预感。
想起来已经接近两个小时没有见到律了，阿纲猛地站了起来。
律是被冻醒的。他睁开眼，发现自己竟然躺在一片雪地里。
看了眼已经有些发青的膝盖，律一时竟站不起来，全身发麻不听使唤。
但是躺在这里他会冻僵的更快，那样他就永远也起不来了。
要怎么办呢…没有人来帮他的话，怕是就要冻死了吧。
有谁…能来救救他…
回应他的只有呼啸的风声，和愈发肆无忌惮的大雪。
好冷…好冷…
就在他哆哆嗦嗦冷的发抖时，从他模糊的视野里出现了一个人影，渐渐一步一步的走近他。
那人温暖的手轻轻将他拉起来，搂在怀里。
那样温暖的怀抱，陌生又熟悉。

那久违的声线让律有一瞬间眼眶发红。
“笑笑。”
“笑笑，我回来了。再也不离开了。”
“笑笑，对不起。”
“笑笑，你是我的全世界。”
“笑笑…我带你回家。”
律在听到这一句话时泪如雨下。
南萧，南萧，南萧。
这个已经刻入骨髓的名字在嘴边百转千回，却怎么也叫不出口。
“不要离开我…”失去的痛苦太可怕，他再也经受不起。
生命不过是一场幻觉，可是我要你在。
生命不过是一场幻觉，而你是我的光。
六道骸看着眼前的少年闭着眼睛静静的流泪，他已经达到了目的，将这个少年用幻觉控制，沉浸其中永远不再醒来。但是为什么，自己的心中竟没有一点喜悦？
为什么他看到自己的幻境中相拥的两人，会感觉到隐隐的悲伤？
为什么他看到少年脸上像是经历过绝望的表情，心里会隐隐作痛？
明明只是个和自己无关的人类而已。
明明自己才是经历过可怕的地狱的那个人。
明明只有自己才懂得什么是真正的绝望。
但在他反应过来之前，他已经轻轻抚上少年的满是泪水的脸。
动作里带着他自己也不曾察觉的温柔。

不许那样看着那个男人。
不许对着那个人露出那种珍惜的表情。
不许为了他再流眼泪。
你只要看着我一个人就好了。
当阿纲和reborn来的时候，就看到了这一幕。
阿纲愤怒的大喊，“放开他！”reborn站在一边，看似平静的脸上看不出任何表情。
六道骸闻声回头，看着阿纲颇有些狼狈的样子，脸上带着明显的不屑和嘲讽。
“哦？如果我说不呢？”
看着阿纲愤怒的样子，六道骸懒洋洋的说，“呐，不好意思，我改变主意了。现在我对你们没有什么兴趣了，趁我没有闲工夫想要收拾你们，现在马上离开这里吧。我可以当做你们的擅闯只是无心之失。”顿了下，六道骸接着道。“不过他，我就留下了。”
阿纲飞快的冲了上去，“开什么玩笑，把小律还给我！”
怒气之下竟然自己点燃了死气之焰的阿纲迅速的打向六道骸，而六道骸一动不动的呆在原地，本以为会将六道骸重伤的阿纲在结结实实的打了一拳之后，却发现眼前的人影消失了，取而代之的是在几步外抱着律的六道骸。
这是怎么回事？
reborn的声音带着些阴沉的响起。“六道骸的能力是幻觉。”
阿纲皱起了眉头，他还从未听说过有这种战斗方式。
以幻觉来战斗，防不胜防。他要如何才能知道什么是真的，什么事假的？
似假亦真，真真假假，谁又能分的那么清楚？
阿纲的沉默中六道骸的笑声从四面八方传来，“kufufufu…撒，找出来吧，真正的我，究竟是哪一个？我只给你三次机会哦，猜不准的话…就送你们入地狱轮回吧！”
阿纲冷哼一声，猛地冲向其中一人。
“不是哦……还有两次机会。”
“轰隆！”伴随着墙壁的坍塌，那个声音又响起。

“啧啧啧…并不是打得声音响、破坏的地方大就算赢哦，要找到人才行。只剩下一次机会了哦。”
“可恶！”阿纲恼火的一拳打向声音传来的地方。
“真可惜。你失败了呢。”
“那么…再见了。”三戟叉飞快的从背后将阿纲打倒在地上，而无法使用列恩的reborn也没能逃过被击倒的命运。
“kuhaha，真是无趣，这么简单就赢了呢。”
走回律的身边，六道骸动作轻柔的将律揽在怀里。
“醒来吧。”
怀中的少年闻声缓缓的睁开了眼睛，有些迷茫的问道。
“你是谁？”
“我是六道骸，是和你一起生活了很久的哥哥哦。”
对上少年的眼睛，看着少年的眼睛变得模糊朦胧然后再重新变得澄澈透明。
“哥哥。”少年乖巧的叫着。
六道骸嘴角化出一抹温柔的弧度。“嗯。我们回家。”
抱着少年向外走去，却听到身后传来带着丝笑意的声音。
“你是要带我回家吗？”
脚步猛地一顿，六道骸不可置信的回头。看看面前的人，在看看怀里的人。
看着面前的少年笑眼弯弯，慢悠悠的道。
“潜藏在幻觉中的有幻觉，从有幻觉中孕育而生的幻觉。潜藏在真实中的谎言，潜藏在谎言中的真实。到底哪个才是真实，哪个才是幻觉呢？亲爱的六道骸。”
六道骸看着律身后一个也不少的彭格列家族的人，又低头看了看自己已经空空如也的臂弯，淡淡的笑了起来。
他一字一句的微笑着道，“你说呢？笑笑……”

律的眼倏地睁大。
话说，亲们这一章有没有看明白捏~大家可以猜一下，哪个是幻觉呢？坏笑
content_en:
Chapter 17 Tutor 5
Lu, who couldn't bear the too lively scene at home, found an excuse and went out.
The weather that had been sunny for days finally turned cooler, and the oncoming breeze felt very comfortable on my face.
Narrowing his eyes in comfort, Ritsu enjoyed this rare quiet atmosphere. Although he didn't mind it in the past few days, it was indeed too noisy.
The cherry blossoms on both sides of Bingsheng Street have opened, and the petals blown by the wind are flying silently in the air, which is as beautiful as a dream.
Lu was a little distracted, and because of this, when he felt someone approaching from behind, he only felt a pain in the back of his neck and lost consciousness.
Gang, who was listening to Reborn teach Italian, was already drowsy, but suddenly frowned subconsciously.
"What's wrong?" Reborn asked warily.
A Gang felt it and couldn't tell what was going on, but he had a bad feeling.
Remembering that he hadn't seen Ritsu for nearly two hours, Gang stood up suddenly.
Lu was woken up by the cold. He opened his eyes and found himself lying in a patch of snow.
Looking at his knees that were already turning blue, Ritsu couldn't stand up for a moment, his whole body was numb and he couldn't control himself.
But lying here would freeze him faster, and he would never get up.
What should he do... If no one comes to help him, he will probably freeze to death.
Who... can come and save him...
The only response to him was the howling wind and the increasingly unbridled snow.
So cold... so cold...
Just as he was shivering and shivering, a figure appeared from his blurred vision and gradually approached him step by step.
The man's warm hands gently pulled him up and held him in his arms.
Such a warm embrace, strange and familiar at the same time.
That long-lost voice made Ritsu's eyes turn red for a moment.
"Smile."
"Xiaoxiao, I'm back. I'll never leave again."
"Xiaoxiao, I'm sorry."
"Smile, you are my world."
"Smile...I'll take you home."
Ritsu burst into tears when she heard this sentence.
Nan Xiao, Nan Xiao, Nan Xiao.
This name that has been engraved in the bone marrow is on my lips a thousand times, but I can't say it out.
"Don't leave me..." The pain of loss was too terrible, and he couldn't bear it anymore.
Life is just an illusion, but I want you here.
Life is just an illusion and you are my light.
Liu Daogui watched the young man in front of him cry quietly with his eyes closed. He had achieved his goal and controlled the young man with hallucinations, immersing him in it and never waking up again. But why is there no joy in my heart?
Why did he feel a faint sadness when he saw the two people embracing each other in his fantasy?
Why did he feel a dull pain in his heart when he saw the despairing expression on the young man's face?
He is obviously just a human being who has nothing to do with him.
It was obvious that he was the one who had experienced the terrible hell.
Obviously only you know what true despair is.
But before he could react, he had already gently touched the boy's tear-stained face.
There was a tenderness in his movements that he had not even noticed.
Don't look at that man like that.
Don't show that cherished expression to that person.
Don't shed any more tears for him.
Just look at me alone.
When A Gang and Reborn came, they saw this scene.
Gang shouted angrily, "Let him go!" Reborn stood aside, with no expression on his seemingly calm face.
Liu Daogui turned around after hearing the sound and looked at A Gang's rather embarrassed look, with obvious disdain and ridicule on his face.
"Oh? What if I say no?"
Seeing A Gang's angry look, Liu Daogui said lazily, "Hey, I'm sorry, I changed my mind. Now I have no interest in you, so I want to deal with you while I don't have free time., leave here now. I can treat your trespassing as an honest mistake. "After a pause, Liu Daogui continued. "But I will stay with him. "
A Gang rushed forward quickly, "Are you kidding? Give Xiaolu back to me! "
Out of anger, A-Gang ignited the flames of death and quickly hit Roku-do Skull, but Roku-do Skeleton stayed on the spot motionless. A-Gang, who thought he would seriously injure Roku Dao-skeleton, gave him a solid punch, but found that the figure in front of him disappeared, and was replaced by Roku-do Skeleton holding Ritsu a few steps away.
What's going on?
Reborn's voice sounded gloomy. "The ability of the Six Paths Skull is an illusion. "
A Gang frowned. He had never heard of such a fighting method.
Fighting with illusions is impossible to guard against. How was he going to know what was real and what was fake?
It seems false but also true, true and false, who can tell the difference so clearly?
Amid Gang's silence, the laughter of Liu Daosu came from all directions, "kufufufu...Sa, find out, who is the real me?" I'll only give you three chances. If you don't guess correctly... I'll send you to hell for reincarnation! "
A Gang snorted and rushed towards one of them.
"No...there are still two chances. "
“Boom! "As the wall collapsed, the voice sounded again.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk... It doesn't mean you win if you fight loudly or cause a lot of damage. You have to find talents. There's only one chance left. "
"Damn it! "A Gang punched the place where the sound came from in anger.
"What a shame. You failed. "
"So...goodbye. "The Trident quickly knocked A Gang to the ground from behind, and Reborn, who was unable to use Len, could not escape the fate of being knocked down.
"Kuhaha, it's so boring to win so easily. "
Walking back to Lu, Liu Daogui gently held Lu in his arms.
"Wake up. "
The young man in his arms slowly opened his eyes when he heard the sound, and asked in confusion.
"Who are you? "
"I am Liu Daogui, my brother who has lived with you for a long time. "
Looking into the boy's eyes, watching the boy's eyes become blurry and then become clear and transparent again.
"Brother. "The boy shouted obediently.
The corners of Liu Daogui's mouth turned into a gentle arc. "Hmm. Let's go home. "
As she walked out with the young man in her arms, she heard a voice with a hint of smile coming from behind her.
"Are you taking me home? "
His footsteps suddenly stopped, and Liu Daogui turned around in disbelief. Look at the person in front of you and the person in your arms.
Looking at the smiling eyes of the young man in front of him, he said slowly.
“There is an illusion hidden in the illusion, an illusion born from the illusion. A lie hidden in the truth, a truth hidden in the lie. Which one is reality and which one is illusion? Dear Six Paths Bones. "
Liu Daogui looked at the many Vongola family members behind Lu, then looked down at his empty arms, and smiled faintly.
He said with a smile every word, "What do you think? Smile..."
Ritsu's eyes widened suddenly.
By the way, dear friends, did you understand this chapter? Can you guess which one is an illusion? smirk
